rows.title: Prediction error against blind held-out experimental references

value.reason: no ledgered run-result store exists and no Level-D blind reference is admitted, so no model-versus-reality error can be computed

rows.does_not_capture: error against a reference bounds nothing on its own: the reference's own uncertainty and the regime it was measured in both constrain what the number means

rows.title: Share of claims replayed bitwise on an independent machine

value.reason: cross-ISA determinism is proven per-artifact by golden couplings and per-host by perf baselines, but no lane aggregates them into a program-level replay rate

rows.does_not_capture: bitwise replay on a second machine proves determinism, not correctness: two machines can reproduce the same wrong number exactly

rows.title: Compliance verdicts flipped by adding a previously omitted budget term

value.reason: no ledger diff of decision verdicts across budget-term introductions is retained; this is the single best evidence that the error-budget program has decision value, and it is not yet collected

rows.does_not_capture: a flipped verdict shows the term mattered on re-run; it does not show the new verdict is correct, only that the earlier one was underdetermined

rows.title: Time from dirty CAD input to a defensible decision artifact

value.reason: no end-to-end acceptance lane records stage timings, so there is nothing to measure without inventing it

rows.does_not_capture: when live this will time OUR examples on OUR hardware, which is not the same as a real user's setup, data, or interruptions

rows.title: Empirical coverage of predicted uncertainty intervals

value.reason: the empirical coverage machinery is not live; nominal coverage is never extrapolated into an empirical claim

rows.does_not_capture: coverage measured on the calibration population says nothing about coverage under the distribution shift a real design study introduces

rows.title: Share of user-facing outputs carrying a complete error budget

value.reason: no audit enumerates user-facing outputs against their budget terms

rows.does_not_capture: a complete budget means every term the model KNOWS about is present; it cannot count terms nobody has identified yet

rows.title: Rate at which adversarial challenges were wrongly accepted

value.reason: zero registered adversarial challenges have been executed, so the rate's denominator is empty; a rate over zero trials is unrepresentable, not zero

rows.does_not_capture: a false-acceptance rate only covers the failure modes someone thought to write a challenge for; it is silent about unimagined ones

rows.title: Human-reviewed supplier CAD files admitted cleanly

value.reason: no supplier import annotation is human-locked yet; proposed outcomes are not a rate denominator

rows.does_not_capture: this rate covers only the retained, human-reviewed population; clean admission is not geometry fidelity, and a file can import cleanly while meaning something different downstream

rows.title: Human-locked supplier import annotations that disagree with current observations
rows.does_not_capture: this is an absolute locked-annotation mismatch count; zero while reviewed is zero means no reviewed regression exposure, not a validated importer

rows.title: Human-reviewed supplier CAD files refused by the standing import policy

value.reason: no supplier import annotation is human-locked yet; proposed outcomes are not a rate denominator

rows.does_not_capture: refusal depends on both corpus difficulty and policy strictness; lowering it by weakening quarantine would not be an improvement

rows.title: Human-reviewed supplier CAD files admitted after repair

value.reason: no supplier import annotation is human-locked yet; proposed outcomes are not a rate denominator

rows.does_not_capture: repair is neither inherently good nor bad: it records that the standing structural policy changed an input before promotion, not that the repaired geometry is equivalent to the supplier's intent

rows.title: Datasets reproduced by an independent team or implementation lineage
rows.does_not_capture: this counts datasets DECLARING the independent-reproduction axis; the declaration is a registry fact, and the current value is a genuine zero rather than an unmeasured one

rows.title: Correctness of certify-or-escalate decisions by learned components

value.reason: no decisive-metrics instrumentation exists for learned components

rows.does_not_capture: escalation correctness is measured against cases where the truth is known, which are systematically the easier ones

rows.title: Time to explain a surprising result through ledger lineage

value.reason: the ledger exposes no explain-query session instrumentation, so no timing surface exists to read

rows.does_not_capture: even when live this measures the tool's explain path, not whether the explanation actually convinced the engineer reading it

rows.title: Setup time, diagnosis time, and decision quality from real user sessions

value.reason: no user-study measurement exists; the nearest current proxies are quickstart timings and the external-reproduction friction log, neither of which is a user study

rows.does_not_capture: proxies measured on people who already know the system are the opposite of the population this metric is supposed to describe

rows.title: Registered adversarial challenges actually executed
rows.does_not_capture: execution is not survival: running a challenge says nothing about whether the program passed it, and an unexecuted suite is a registry of good intentions

rows.title: Validation datasets on the blind-predictive axis
rows.does_not_capture: the honesty exam: a prediction made before the reference was unblinded. The current value is a real zero, which is the single most important number on this dashboard

rows.title: Validation datasets supplying an external evidence axis
rows.does_not_capture: external means cross-code, controlled-experimental, blind-predictive, or field monitoring; our own numerical verification is deliberately excluded from the numerator because agreeing with ourselves is not external evidence

rows.title: Claim cells carrying at least one external reference
rows.does_not_capture: anchoring counts REFERENCES attached to a cell, not agreement with them; a cell can be anchored and still predict the reference badly

rows.title: Claim cells with no external reference at all
rows.does_not_capture: an absolute count, so it grows when the program declares new claim cells; a rising number can mean expanding scope rather than decaying evidence

rows.title: Open beads with no open blocker, from the tracker snapshot
rows.does_not_capture: directionless on purpose: actionable count falls when work completes AND when new blocked work is filed, so neither rise nor fall is inherently good

rows.title: Open beads with at least one open blocker, from the tracker snapshot
rows.does_not_capture: a deliberately regenerated snapshot ratio; the live tracker moves on every br op and is not a checked input, so this row trails the tracker by design

rows.title: Registered capabilities at L2 (numerically verified) or above
rows.does_not_capture: registry levels are declarations backed by cited evidence, not independent audits; the registry's own maturity is L1

rows.title: Registered capabilities at L3 (integrated workflow) or above
rows.does_not_capture: L3 requires an admitted end-to-end integration claim; the current value is a real zero, and no crate count or test count can move it

rows.title: Reality-check spine beads on the certified tropical critical path
sources: tropical-critical-path.json (fs-tropical over the bead graph, xtask tropical-path)
rows.does_not_capture: slack is computed over ESTIMATES with a recorded default for unestimated beads; a spine bead off the path buys nothing by being rushed, and one on it sets the makespan

rows.title: Staged-producer e2e lane stages proven green by a retained checked receipt
rows.does_not_capture: counts stages the retained receipt proves green on one host at one HEAD; it does not prove the stages' answers correct, and a stale receipt is refused by the spine-metrics gate when the product's stage boundary moves

rows.title: Solve pipeline stages executing in the checked spine ratchet
rows.does_not_capture: counts the executing stage PREFIX the product admits and the ratchet pins; it proves the stages execute, not that their answers are correct

excluded.reason: a performance diagnostic owned by the roofline lane; a faster kernel is not a better prediction
inventory, not capability; the capability maturity registry is the outcome measure
inventory, not proof; check-docs already pins it and a test file is not an outcome
